label: 86 Chaos 17.0.15
releaseTitle: Schedule Publish Canonical Roster Parity Repair
notes: Allows active tenant users that are not yet represented by workspaceMembers to participate in schedule identity resolution without granting any additional application permissions.
Treats client-confirmed shifts that the authoritative server will not write as safe no-write evidence instead of failing the entire publish operation with candidate_set_changed.
Still fails closed if the server intends to write any shift that the client did not confirm.
title: 86 Chaos 17.0.15
summary: Precision repair for the remaining schedule publication candidate mismatch on legacy/canonical roster data.
description: Makes the server publication roster resolve the same tenant users the Schedule Builder can resolve, while keeping server-authoritative write selection and stale-write protections intact.
